settings.heading: Details
settings.content:
• Front pet pouch with a soft, fluffy opening for your pet's head
  • Four festive designs: Holly Wreath, Candy Pink, Santa Red and Christmas Tree
  • Two zip side pockets and a zip chest pocket
  • Cozy hoodie with drawstring hood

settings.heading: Safe cuddles
settings.content:
• Best for kittens, cats and small pets who sit comfortably in the pouch.
  • Always support your pet from below with your arms. The pouch is for cuddles, not hands-free carrying.
  • Don't use it while driving, cycling, cooking or doing anything where your pet could get hurt.
  • Start with a few minutes at home and let your pet climb out whenever they want. Never leave them in the pouch unattended or in the heat.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Turn inside out. Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, or hand wash. Air-dry flat. Don't tumble dry, bleach or iron the decorations.

settings.heading: Shipping & Christmas delivery
settings.content:
Free shipping worldwide. US orders usually arrive in 9–17 days; Canada, the UK and Australia in 10–20 days; most other countries in 12–25 days. All taxes and import duties are included.

For Christmas: order by December 5 (US), December 2 (Canada, UK, Australia) or November 28 (other countries). Full shipping policy

settings.heading: Our guarantee
settings.content: If it arrives damaged or faulty, send a photo to support@suzeno.com within 30 days and we'll refund you or send a replacement. Wrong size? Email us and we'll help.

settings.question: How does the pet pouch work?
settings.answer: There's a roomy pouch on the front with a soft, fluffy opening at chest height. Your cat sits in the pouch, supported by your arms, and pokes their head out to see the world while staying close to you.

settings.question: What size should I choose?
settings.answer: Pick your usual size: the hoodie has a relaxed, roomy fit to make space for your pet. Between sizes, or carrying a bigger cat? Size up. See the Size guide on this page for exact measurements.

settings.question: Which pets is it for?
settings.answer: Best for kittens, cats and small pets who sit comfortably in the pouch. Every pet is different, so start with short cuddle sessions at home.

settings.question: Will it arrive before Christmas?
settings.answer: To be safe, order by December 5 for the US, December 2 for Canada, the UK and Australia, and November 28 for other countries. Orders to the US usually arrive in 9–17 days; Canada, the UK and Australia in 10–20 days; most other countries in 12–25 days.

settings.question: Is it only for pet owners?
settings.answer: Not at all. It's a cozy, festive hoodie on its own, with two zip side pockets. The pouch just makes it extra fun with a cat.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Turn it inside out and machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, or hand wash. Air-dry flat; don't tumble dry or iron the decorations.

settings.question: Will I pay customs fees or taxes?
settings.answer: No. Our prices include all taxes and import duties, so the price at checkout is the final price. If a carrier ever asks you for a fee, contact us before paying and we'll take care of it.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit or arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact support@suzeno.com within 30 days of delivery. If it arrives damaged or faulty, we'll refund you or send a replacement. For a different size, email us and we'll help.
